o: Why?
? What's broken?
Different how?
You need to explain properly for me to understand.

chat.t: I'm at your door. Open it

o: What the...

chat.t: Please take good care of my request.
But you told me to do something earlier

o: I told you to check if there's anything uncomfortable when you sleep
Since you said your daily routine is just loafing around anyway
it's highly likely that the problem happens when you're sleeping.

chat.t: And I'm not loafing around. I'm conserving energy

o: Yeah.

lines.t: Chronoscholar Manor
This is Chronoscholar Manor.
The estate of a prestigious family dedicated to mastering time magic.
They carry out grueling research and experiments daily to achieve their goals.
And the Head Butler, who supports them in every possible way, also...
continues her own fierce battle every day.
Chronoscholar Lab
*Yawn*...
Dining Hall
Meat tastes good.
*Yawwwwn*.
Dust spotted.
Manor Hallway
Claire's Bedroom
Mmm...
Then, one day, amidst those fierce daily routines...
Hideout
...So, to sum up your story.
You can't sleep, so you want me to help you fall asleep?
Yes. It's my first time experiencing this.
Nothing else has changed.
Strangely, I just can't sleep.
Do you know why I can't sleep?
Well, I wouldn't really know that.
But I can tell you're definitely an unemployed slacker who does nothing but loaf around.
I'm not unemployed.
I'm following orders to stockpile energy.
I'm preparing for the future, not just loafing around.
Sure, sure. That's what they all say.
It's true.
I'm the Head Butler of the Chronoscholar family.
It's usually a really tough job with a lot to worry about.
But I can see why you'd misunderstand. I'm on a different mission right now anyway.
A different mission? What is it?
A mission to absolutely do nothing and just monitor.
If there's something to do, I remember it and make the House Elf do it.
They said my mission is to keep a close eye on the manor like that.
So what you're saying is, you got demoted from Head Butler to home security guard.
Home security guard...
Yes. That describes me perfectly.
And I told you, it's not a demotion, I'm just saving energy.
...Sure, let's just go with that.
Yes. So not being able to sleep is a big problem.
I'm in worse shape than usual, and I get hungry more often.
So fix it quickly.
Wait, do you think this place is some kind of playground?
Go ask a hospital about that.
The hospital is a bit difficult due to circumstances.
Can't you solve a problem like this?
I even brought the commission fee.
Claire showed me something.
How many zeros is this... one, two, three, four, five, six, seven, ei...
If this isn't enough, I'll go somewhere else.
Hey.
Yeah?
Since when has this been happening?

o: Wdym the pillow

chat.t: I looked for anything uncomfortable like you said
And I think the pillow is the problem

o: Well, then you can just buy a new one.
Wanna go today?
Ok
So when are we going to fix the pillow?

chat.t: Since I don't sleep, I'm low on energy
I'll call you after I eat some more meat

o: Wouldn't it be better to just get it over with?

chat.t: Then I'll go first thing tomorrow
In return, you have to carry me on your back the whole time

o: Eat plenty of meat, store up lots of energy, and then contact me.

lines.t: I headed to the rendezvous point to meet Claire and buy a new pillow.

Though I couldn't help but wonder
what kind of person can't sleep over a single pillow...
"Restaurant"
Well, she's still a client, so I don't have much of a choice.
Mmm?
It's nothing.
You're done eating, right? Shall we go buy a pillow now?
(Munch, munch)
No, still not enough. I want to eat more.
...You've eaten that much and it's still not enough?
Yes. I have to stockpile more energy than usual.
Because not being able to sleep is an emergency right now.
But if I eat tons of meat beforehand, I'll be fine.
How much more do you have to eat?
Hm.
Just one more time.
Well, if it's just that much—
The same amount I've eaten so far, one more time.
Right, she's a client, so I have no choice...
More meat here, please.
Sorry, but we're about to take a break...

And so, somehow we left the restaurant
and headed to a nearby shopping mall to buy a new pillow.
But...
Shopping Mall 6F
Not this one.
The texture is weird.
Feel my pillow. It's completely different from this one.
Okay, next.
Not this one either.
It's soft, but uncomfortable.
Try resting your head on my pillow. It's completely different from this one.
...Okay, next.
No.
No.
It's weird.
Downtown
Where are we going now? To eat meat?
Ah, I get it.
Just don't use a pillow. A pillow is a luxury for you.
I can't do that. I tried it already, and I still couldn't sleep.
If I don't sleep, it's hard to control my energy, which is dangerous.
And I'm not full. Not enough meat.
How can you say it's not enough after eating that much?
That wasn't enough.
Since I can't sleep, I have to replenish much more than usual.
If only I could find a good pillow, I'd be able to sleep soundly.
...Wait, you haven't slept a single wink this whole time?
Yeah. Like I said before, I just can't sleep.
I'm a Homunculus, so I can manage without sleep for a bit.
But if I end up unable to sleep like this forever, that could be a problem.
Sigh...
Then for now... let's try to fix the one you used before.
Okay.
But how are we even supposed to fix a pillow...?
You definitely said you couldn't sleep because the pillow was uncomfortable.
Specifically, what exactly felt uncomfortable compared to before?
The pillow felt hard, somehow.
Right, I didn't expect much anyway.
Let's just go back to the store first.
Oh! It's that incredibly picky—
*Ahem!* Hello, customers! Would you like to try this pillow this time?
It's a bit pricey, but you definitely won't be disappointed!
Ah, it's not that.
I explained the situation to the clerk.
So... you want to fix the pillow you were using before?
Hmm, could you show it to me first?
Hmm, oho.
They don't sell meat here?
Please be quiet.
...Huh?
This isn't just a regular pillow.
Hmm? What do you mean?
I mean, it looks like a normal pillow at first glance...
But if you look at the stuffing inside, it's been treated with highly sophisticated magic.
Magic treatment? Why is something like that on it?
Why are you asking me?
Enchanted furniture itself isn't that rare...
But an item with such advanced magic, especially on a pillow... is something I've never seen before.
Can you fix it?
It's difficult here. If it were a simple spell, maybe.
It would probably be faster to request a specialist artisan for this.
Or we could just ask the person who enchanted it, right?
Of course. That would be the fastest way.
I see. Thanks, that helps.
Seriously, if it was a magic pillow, you should've said so sooner.
I didn't know either. I've been using it since a long time ago.
But if it had magic on it, I have a guess.
It was probably a device that regulated the energy inside my body.
It automatically regulated my energy while I slept.
And when it broke, the regulation function stopped working, and you couldn't sleep?
Yes. Probably.
Well, at least we found the cause.
If we ask someone from your family, they should be able to figure something out.
I can't do that.
I don't want to. I feel like I'll get scolded.
What the... then are you just not going to sleep until the pillow is fixed?
That's why I made a request to you, Fixer.
Solve it somehow.
Sigh...
Flop—!!
Suddenly, Claire lay down right on the street.
?? What are you doing all of a sudden?
I used up all my energy today.
Carry me. I can't move.
...You really are a piece of work.
Why are you so hopelessly lazy?
Who are you calling lazy? I told you, I'm on a mission.
I said I'm saving energy for the future.
And thanks to that, I was able to hold out even when I was low on energy from not sleeping.
...But even though I knew something like this might happen, my energy was much lower than expected.
I'll store it even more diligently from now on.
Says the one sprawled out on the ground...
Hmm...
Well, you certainly seem to have stockpiled a lot.
What are you looking at?
Your energy storage tanks.
What is that... Ah.
Wait. You can see where they are?
Do you happen to know a lot about Homunculus?
If so, do you know how to regulate the energy in my body?
No, you dummy. How would I know that?
Just get up already.
...Hmph.
I can't get up. Help me up.
You're really high-maintenance.
Where are we going now?
Well, since the pillow is actually a magic tool...
Is there any place in Vermont famous for that kind of stuff?
Yes.
If we go there and look around, we might find out something.
Alright, let's head over right now.
What is it now?
I told you, I used up all my energy today.
Sigh... fine.
We can go next time then. I'm leaving.
Where are you going?
Going home. Why?
You have to take me back to the manor.
I told you I can't move.
Why should I?
Is it okay if I pay you more?
...Understood.
Alright, let's head back home then.
...Why do you keep squeezing there?
I have no choice if I'm carrying you.
Deal.
After taking Claire back to the manor like that, I returned to the Hideout.

chat.t: Let's go fix the pillow today

o: Sure, then let's meet at that square from before.

chat.t: I need to conserve as much energy as possible

o: You really are a piece of work.
What now?
Of course you can't, we haven't fixed it yet.
I told you we should go next time.

chat.t: I think I'll be fine until then if I have that pillow from earlier.
Why don't you sell ownership of it to me?

o: ????? What are you talking about?
How are you any different from that quack from earlier today?

chat.t: I'll give you everything I have.

o: Do you think you can buy me with that measly money?

chat.t: I'll book a request for tomorrow.
You're lying down with me all day.
I'll share my meat with you.

o: This brat keeps trying to buy me with money...
Confirmed.

lines.t: Vermont Magic Street
I took Claire, who was loafing around the manor, and headed to the magic street.

I don't know why she keeps asking me to drop her off
and pick her up like she's some kid, but...
Well, she's still a client, so I don't have much of a choice.
Mmm?
It's nothing.
I should've had it packed up so I could carry it around from the start.
(Munch, munch)
That's a problem. I'm on an important mission.
I'm sorry, but I can't stay with you forever.
? What are you talking about all of a sudden?
You said you wanted to pack me up and carry me around. That's a no-go.
But sometimes is fine. When I'm not busy.
What kind of nonsense... I meant the meat in your hand, not you.
Hm.
Where to now? To fix the pillow?
I did some digging, and apparently there's a famous magic tool repair shop.
I heard there are plenty of others clustered around here, too, so we're bound to find something if we look around.
Okay.
Alright, let's get going.
You two over there! Hold on a second!
Hm?
I couldn't help but overhear. Do you have something that needs repairing?
If so, why not let me take a crack at it?
Who are you?
Oh, I'm just an apprentice training at a nearby workshop!
I've been appraising magic tools as part of my training, and I think I can help you out.
I won't charge you anything, of course. Though I won't say no to a tip!
Who knows? It might be a really simple fix that I can handle.
...Well, why don't we at least hear her out?
It's not like we have anything to lose.
Okay. Sure.
Here. This is the broken pillow.
Claire handed over her pillow.
A p-pillow...? Well, this is unusual...
Heh, anyway, leave it to yours truly.
Mm-hmm, I see.
...Huh?? Th-this is...
Why? What's wrong?
...Yikes, this is no good. It's completely ruined.
Ruined?
Do you see this mana circuit? Look how warped it is.
It's a goner, I tell you. The magic inside must be completely jumbled up.
...Jumbled up?
Hm, is it really that bad...
Absolutely. It's like a ticking time bomb that could blow up if you touch it wrong...
...Ahem, but then again, it's actually perfect for research purposes.
How about selling it to me? Carrying around <bouten>junk</bouten> like this is only going to weigh you down, right?
(I feel like I've seen this pattern somewhere before.)
...It's not junk. And it won't blow up.
Give it back, you quack.
Q-Quack?! Hey, that's going way too far!
I was just trying to do you a favor, and you call me a q-u-a-c-k?!
That is so uncalled for!
...Huh?
W-Whoaaaa!!??
Wh-Wh-Wh-Where am I?!!
Gwah!!!
Wh-What?! Did that person just fall from the sky?
My friend in Humanitas told me to watch out for people falling from the sky...!
...I heard that too, but since they're not naked, I think they're fine.
Besides, I saw it. They didn't fall from the sky—they were launched from the ground.
That girl barely even touched them... Could she be—
...Ah, um.
Uh... mm... u-ugh...
...Fi-Fixer. This is... well.
...*Sigh.*
What the hell did you do?
Ugh...
Weren't you on a mission to conserve energy?
Yeah...?
Well, that was certainly effective. So much for saving your energy.
Don't tell me you just burned through your entire energy reserve for the day on that?
...I can't move.
Good grief. Hurry up and get on my back, then.
...Understood.
We had drawn way too much attention to ourselves to drop by the repair shop...
So, we headed straight back to Chronoscholar Manor.
Claire's Room
I'm exhausted.
*Flop!*
Claire collapsed onto her bed.
I'm not moving a single inch today.
Because I'm on an energy conservation mission.
Hey, you can't just lie down without washing up first.
I don't care. The House Elf will take care of it.
How did such a hopeless slacker end up as the head butler anyway?
Hmph. I'm not hopeless. I'm just conserving energy.
Besides, I used up way too much energy today.
And I couldn't even get my pillow fixed, so I can't recharge either.
...Well, we can try again next time.
Hm... Actually, losing a bit of sleep is fine.
I can manage if I just eat more meat to make up for it.
So bring me some meat. For energy restoration.
You can just ask the House Elf to prepare it.
...Sure, sure. Go wash up in the meantime.
You do it. Wash me.
Really?
...Suddenly I feel uneasy. Never mind that.
Anyway, I'm just going to lie down for a bit. I'm tired.
You really are an unwavering unemployed slacker.
I'm not unemployed.
Besides, even you won't be able to resist this bed.
Why don't you... try lying... down here too, mumble...
Zzz...
Seriously? You said you couldn't sleep, but you're already out cold.
I'm getting kind of tired too...
Yawwwm.
Did I fall asleep?
I feel... refreshed somehow.
Could it be...
...*Yawn.*
...What are you doing?
Testing my pillow.
What was that?
Soft and comfy. Feels good.
I'm staying like this forever.
What do you mean forever? Move it.
I'll pay you more for the request.
Deal.
